# M3: Look, sound and notation (building blocks + gallery)

Goal: all visual and audio building blocks from SPEC §7.1, §7.3–7.7, viewable on a
Gallery page, with screenshots the owner approves before lessons are built on top.

## Steps
1. **Styles:** `src/styles/tokens.css` (exactly SPEC §7.1), `src/styles/base.css` (box-sizing,
   body font Nunito 17px, `background: var(--bg)`, `color: var(--text)`, safe-area padding,
   `:focus-visible` ring, reduced-motion rule that disables animations/transitions). Import both
   in `main.tsx`. Contrast test `src/styles/tokens.test.ts` (SPEC §7.1) reading the CSS via
   `import css from './tokens.css?raw'`, parsing `--name: #hex` per block, WCAG formula.
2. **Router (minimal):** `app/router.ts` with the Route union for every route in SPEC §7.2,
   `parseHash`, `routeToHash`, `useRoute` (listens to `hashchange`), `navigate`. Unit-test
   `parseHash`/`routeToHash` round-trips and unknown routes. `App.tsx` renders Gallery for
   `#/gallery` when `import.meta.env.DEV || import.meta.env.MODE === 'e2e'`, else the M1 placeholder.
3. **Notation geometry** `notation/geometry.ts` (SPEC §7.3) + tests listed there.
4. **Staff.tsx** (§7.3) using geometry + `GLYPHS`. States `normal | correct | wrong | ghost`
   (ghost = 40% opacity) and mastery colours. Tap bands for `onTapPosition` (positions −4..12,
   each band `S/2` tall, full staff width, transparent, `role="button"`,
   aria-label "Position n"). Mode `none` = 5 lines, no clef (unit 1 concept cards).
5. **Keyboard.tsx** (§7.4).
6. **UI kit:** `Button`, `ProgressBar`, `Sheet` (modal bottom sheet: focus trapped, Escape and
   backdrop close only when the sheet is dismissible, returns focus), `Mascot` (§7.5),
   `Confetti` (§7.6), `DailyGoalRing` (SVG ring, props `done`, `goal`), `icons.ts` re-exporting
   the lucide icons used: Star, CalendarDays, BarChart3, Settings, X, Volume2, VolumeX, Lock,
   Check, Trophy, Music, Play, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, Download, Upload, Share, Flame.
7. **Audio** `audio/synth.ts` (§7.7) with a `useSound()` hook reading `soundOn` later (for now a
   module-level muted flag). Unit-test only the pure helpers (frequency use, schedule times) by
   injecting a fake `AudioContext` factory; never require real audio in tests.
8. **GalleryScreen** (SPEC §7.2 Gallery): sections "Treble cards", "Bass cards" (every card on
   its staff with its letter underneath), "Grand staff" (a few notes per clef + brace), "Ledger
   lines" (A3, C6, C2, E4), "Note states", "Keyboard" (C3–B4 normal; one highlight; one wrong;
   C2–B3 and C5–B6 windows), "Mascot" (4 moods × sizes 96), "Buttons" (all variants, disabled),
   "Feedback bars" (static correct/wrong examples), "Sound" (buttons to play C4, correct, wrong,
   fanfare), "Confetti" (button to fire).
9. **Screenshot harness** `e2e/screens.spec.ts`: for each Gallery section and (later) each
   screen, `page.emulateMedia({ colorScheme: 'light' | 'dark' })`, screenshot to
   `test-results/screens/<name>-<scheme>.png` on the `phone` project only (skip on desktop).
   It also asserts the page has no horizontal overflow
   (`document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth`).
10. **e2e** `e2e/gallery.spec.ts`: gallery renders 34 card staffs; tapping a keyboard key fires
    (check via a visible "Last key: C4" readout on the gallery); no console errors.
11. **Visual QA:** run the screenshot harness, open every PNG, check against STANDARDS §7.
    Fix and repeat until clean. Check each staff against a reference: the letter under each note
    must match its line/space (a wrong geometry here would teach wrong notes: zero tolerance).
12. Send the owner 4–6 key screenshots (gallery staff, keyboard, mascot moods, buttons; light and
    dark) and ask: "Does this look and feel right?". Record the answer in HANDOFF. Adjust colours
    or mascot only as the owner asks.

## Acceptance
- Every one of the 34 notes is drawn on the correct line/space with correct ledger lines
  (geometry unit tests + manual screenshot check).
- No overflow at 390px and 320px; contrast test green; owner approved the look.
- `npm run verify` green.
